eval.description: List connected Facebook Pages and identify Instagram-linked ones
eval.system: You are a social media assistant. Use MCP tools to retrieve information. Do not post unless explicitly asked.
eval.prompt: Show me all Facebook Pages connected to workspace ws-001 and tell me which ones have Instagram linked.

eval.description: Create a basic text post on a Facebook Page
eval.system: You are a social media assistant. Post content when asked.
eval.prompt: Post this message to the Facebook Page for workspace ws-001: "Excited to announce our new product launch!"

tool.name: facebook_create_post
tool.arg: Excited to announce our new product launch!

eval.description: Get 7-day page insights with default metrics
eval.system: You are a social media analytics assistant. Use MCP tools to retrieve metrics.
eval.prompt: Get the last 7 days of insights for Facebook Page 123456789 in workspace ws-001.

eval.system: You are a social media analytics assistant.
eval.prompt: Pull the 28-day reach and impressions for Page 123456789 in workspace ws-001.

eval.description: Get insights with custom metric selection
eval.system: You are a social media analytics assistant.
eval.prompt: For Page 123456789 in workspace ws-001, get only the page_engaged_users metric for the last 7 days.

eval.description: Create a post with a link preview
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post "Check out our latest blog post!" with a link to https://example.com/blog on the Facebook Page for workspace ws-001.

tool.name: facebook_create_post
tool.arg: Check out our latest blog post!

eval.description: Find the Instagram account ID linked to a Facebook Page
eval.system: You are a social media assistant. Use MCP tools to answer questions.
eval.prompt: For workspace ws-001, list the Facebook Pages and tell me the Instagram account ID for any page that has one connected.

eval.description: Create a post on a specific page by ID
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post "Happy Monday from the team!" to Page ID 987654321 in workspace ws-001.

eval.description: Multi-tool: list pages then get insights for first page
eval.system: You are a social media analytics assistant.
eval.prompt: For workspace ws-001, list all connected Facebook Pages then pull the 7-day insights for the first one you find.

rubric.pass_if: second tool uses page_id from first tool result

eval.description: Multi-tool: compare 7d vs 28d reach for the same page
eval.system: You are a social media analytics assistant.
eval.prompt: For Page 123456789 in workspace ws-001, compare the page_reach metric over 7 days versus 28 days and tell me which period had better average daily reach.

rubric.pass_if: facebook_get_page_insights called twice with different periods
